title: Pulp skill_path_map.json
description: Skill name -> ownership globs, consumed by skill_sync_check.py. Validated for real by skill_path_map_lint.py (via json_schema_lite.py) on every gates.sh / pre-push / CI run.

$schema.description: Relative pointer to this file. The lint asserts the referenced file exists, so a dangling pointer is an error rather than decoration.

skills.description: One entry per directory under .agents/skills/. skill_sync_check.self_check enforces the two-way correspondence.

propertyNames.description: Skill directory name: lowercase kebab-case, matching the .agents/skills/ subdirectory.

additionalProperties.description: A skill's ownership entry. Always an object — a bare array here parses to zero patterns under load_skill_map(), which is a silent no-op entry.

paths.description: Repo-relative gitignore-style globs (see gate_common.glob_to_regex). An empty array is allowed only with a _doc.empty-ok annotation.

items.description: Anchored at the repo root: no leading '/' or './', no backslashes, no whitespace, no '..' segment, no doubled or trailing slash. A leading dot is fine — .github/ and .agents/ are real ownership surfaces.

_doc.description: Annotations that unlock a lint rule. Each value must state why, not that.

empty-ok.description: Why this entry's patterns legitimately match no tracked file (developer-supplied external SDK, or a process skill that owns no source path).

scope.description: Why this skill co-claims an entire subsystem directory that another skill also claims.
